qolFindings.title: The V9-1 fix moved the boundary rather than closing it. Some grouped telephones are still shown as 'not a telephone', and a spaced date followed by an age is now ignored without being shown
qolFindings.scenario: Probes round10/r10v and r10w, readPhone false, line 'Veldor;Marta;;16;<value>'. (a) '02.12.34 56', '06-12-34 56' and '12.34.56 78' make the line unread with 'nella colonna Telefono c’è «…», che non è un telefono', because the first DATE_SHAPE alternative accepts dotted or dashed pairs followed by a trailing age. V5F-4 says 'a telephone, even malformed or written in groups, is still ignored'. (b) '01 02 14 16', '12 03 2011 15', '3 4 08 12' and '01 02 2014 16' are ignored as telephones. '12 03 10 16' and '1 2 2014 16' are shown, only because their digits contain 19xx or 20xx. With the Età column empty ('Veldor;Marta;;;01 02 14 16'), the student is read with no date and no age, and the pasted date never appears. The row then needs the missing field typed, so nothing is saved wrong. The V9-1 disposition names the '01 02 2014 16' case. Both cases need an assistant that ignores the prompt and fills the Telefono column.
qolFindings.suggestedFix: Reword V5F-4 to name the grouped shapes that are shown. Optionally, with the telephone off and the Età column empty, show a four-group spaced value whose first three groups read as a day, a month and a year.
